_why: Each suite's assertion TOTAL. run.mjs fails a suite whose total drops below this even when every assertion passes — 6C-0 found team-contract had quietly gone from 49 checks to 48 because a stray fixture made it take a skip branch, and nothing was red. A number going DOWN in this file's diff is the thing to stop and read.
_howToChange: Add assertions, get the suite green, then `node scripts/verify/run.mjs <name> --update`. Never --update to make a drop go away. A BRAND-NEW suite needs no hand-written entry: it runs unpinned, reports NEW, and is counted NOT CLEAN until one --update pins it — so a suite written and forgotten shows up every run instead of silently not running.
_notInHere: chooser-e2e, final-verify, signin-check, check-scss-depth, lh, measure, shoot-site, site-audit — these report differently or are not assertion suites. signin-check is the sign-in canary (see lib/login.mjs) and is run on its own.
_sqlSuites: The T-SQL suites under jp-backend/database/<db>/99_tests. Added to the runner in 8A (G9): they were documented in HOW_TO_RUN as seven sqlcmd lines and were therefore outside the regression — anyone running run.mjs ran 34 suites and believed they had run 41. Counted by result MARKERS, not by their own summary line, because 003_test_school_team prints two summaries and the second is a subset.
